## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- MS-P5-GNN dispatcher E2E

- wedm_lattice_stats → returns counts after build
- wedm_gnn_init then wedm_gnn_attend → returns 64-dim refined embedding
- wedm_gnn_train → reports steps and loss values
- wedm_gnn_save then wedm_gnn_load → round-trip succeeds
